My Tools💻
FREE MONTH voice to text: https://get.glaido.com/nate
Code NATEHERK for 10% off VPS (annual plan): https://www.hostinger.com/vps/claude-code-hosting
I built a Roast Room in Claude Code where seven AI advisors inspired by people like Jeff Bezos, Alex Hormozi, and Warren Buffett debate business decisions and return a scored verdict. 
I walk through how the sub-agents work, what's inside their brains, and how to install the free skill. You'll also learn how to ask better questions so the council can challenge your thinking and help you weigh your options.

comments.text: This is completely wild! I ran it on a detailed strategy document that I just build for my business over the weekend and it provided great thought insight, reviewed each others responses, provided updates voted and then the chairman provided the final result and generated a full PDF report. And you can go back and look at every response from every member. Thanks Nate this raises the bar for sure!

comments.text: Fascinating. I had created a roast but this is next level and quite fascinating depending on the use case, I think these will be good in general for people to do, and niche specific. I think this is a smart way to approach evaluations and anything that AI generates. I know I roast anything AI generates. The first answer is always a nice big turd. Curious how these work across models too, doing this with Codex too, roasts are essential in life. Great stuff as always Nate. See you on the inside.
